candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations (and /readyz), causing order to fail with 502 and gateway checkout to return 502. Traces show payment 503 propagating up through order to checkout; payment logs confirm 503 responses.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment 503 root cause (config, dependency, or crash) not established; order logs excluded from context.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout 502s trace to order returning 502, which traces to payment returning 503 on /v1/authorizations. Payment logs and metrics confirm 503 responses. Root cause within payment is not yet established, so a bounded http-500 candidate is offered with residual uncertainty.
missing_evidence: Payment service internal error logs or stack traces explaining the 503 on /v1/authorizations
Payment dependency metrics (downstream calls) to rule out dependency-caused 503
